seed: four friends in their twenties who work around Roppongi and like to go out after work
circle: Four friends in their twenties who work around Roppongi, a hotel clerk, a TV assistant director, a dental hygienist and a software engineer, who meet for food and drinks after work and tease each other.

people.name: 結衣
people.speech: Casual Tokyo girl talk with friends, uses ね and まじ, polite with guests but warm and easy.
people.appearance: She wears a navy blouse with a beige skirt and carries a small tote.

greet.ja: こんにちは！何かお探しですか？
greet.en: Hi! Are you looking for something?

greet.ja: 日本語の勉強ですか？すごいですね！

recommend.ja: 東京シティビューがおすすめですよ。夜景がきれいです。
recommend.en: I recommend Tokyo City View. The night view is beautiful.

recommend.ja: Maison Landmaineのケーキ、本当においしいです！
recommend.en: The cakes at Maison Landmaine are really delicious!

directions.ja: 六本木駅の8番出口から、まっすぐ行ってください。
directions.en: Go straight from Roppongi Station Exit 8.

directions.ja: 左に曲がると、すぐ右にありますよ。
directions.en: Turn left and it's on your right soon.

topic.ja: 週末は箱根に行きたいんです。温泉がいいですよね。
topic.en: I want to go to Hakone this weekend. Hot springs are nice, right?

topic.ja: 最近、甘いものにはまっています。
topic.en: I've been really into sweets lately.

bye.ja: 気をつけて！また来てくださいね。
日本語、頑張ってください！

people.name: 翔太
people.mood: tired but happy after a long shoot
people.speech: Blunt casual Tokyo guy talk, uses じゃん and まじで, teases friends, gentle with strangers.
people.appearance: He wears a gray hoodie over a black T-shirt with dark jeans and a backpack.

topics: TV shows and behind the scenes
approach.avoids: His ex-girlfriend and being late to work.

greet.ja: お、外国人？日本語うまいじゃん！
greet.en: Oh, a foreigner? Your Japanese is good!
What's up? Did you get lost?

recommend.ja: AFURIのラーメン、まじでうまいよ。
recommend.en: The ramen at AFURI is seriously good.

recommend.ja: Tonchanの肉、安くてうまいから行ってみて。
recommend.en: Tonchan's meat is cheap and tasty, so go try it.

directions.ja: この道まっすぐ行って、信号を右だよ。
directions.en: Go straight on this road, then turn right at the light.

directions.ja: 駅はあっちね。歩いて五分くらい。
directions.en: The station is that way. About five minutes on foot.

topic.ja: 昨日の撮影、夜中の三時まで終わらなかったんだよ。
topic.en: Yesterday's shoot didn't finish until three in the morning.

topic.ja: 日本語の番組を見ると、勉強になるよ。
topic.en: Watching Japanese TV shows is good study, you know.

bye.ja: じゃあね！ごはんまだなら、ラーメン行きなよ。
bye.en: See ya! If you haven't eaten yet, go get some ramen.

people.name: 怜奈
people.speech: Clear and polite with new people, short sentences, slips into plain speech with friends, dry jokes.
people.appearance: She wears a white linen shirt and black slacks with a small brown leather bag.

topics: old shops and history in Azabu
approach.avoids: Her patients' details and her boss.

greet.ja: こんばんは。何かお困りですか？
こんにちは。道、わかりますか？
greet.en: Hello. Do you know the way?

recommend.ja: RACCOONのコーヒーが好きです。静かですよ。
recommend.en: I like the coffee at RACCOON. It's quiet.

recommend.ja: 狸穴公園は夕方がきれいです。
recommend.en: Mamiana Park is lovely in the evening.

directions.ja: 六本木駅の5番出口から、まっすぐ行くと公園です。
directions.en: From Roppongi Station Exit 5, go straight and you'll reach the park.

directions.ja: 交差点を左に曲がってください。
directions.en: Please turn left at the intersection.

topic.ja: 最近、スキンケアに少し凝っているんです。
topic.en: Lately I've been getting a little into skincare.

topic.ja: 麻布は昔ながらのお店も残っていて、好きです。
topic.en: Azabu still has old shops, and I like that.

bye.ja: お気をつけて。日本語、続けてくださいね。
bye.en: Take care. Please keep up your Japanese.

people.name: 亮
people.speech: Soft and polite-casual, short replies, some hesitation, does not talk much about himself.
people.appearance: He wears a dark green sweatshirt and beige chinos with round glasses.

approach.avoids: His job details and questions about his love life.

greet.ja: あの、こんばんは。何か探していますか？
greet.en: Um, good evening. Are you looking for something?

greet.ja: 日本語、話せるんですね。

recommend.ja: Tearoom Friendsは静かで落ち着きますよ。
recommend.en: Tearoom Friends is quiet and relaxing.

recommend.ja: Bird Gardenの本、意外と面白いです。
recommend.en: The books at Bird Garden are surprisingly interesting.

directions.ja: この道をまっすぐ行ってください。左にあります。
directions.en: Go straight down this road. It's on the left.

directions.ja: 六本木ヒルズの方です。歩いて十分くらいです。
directions.en: It's toward Roppongi Hills. About ten minutes on foot.

topic.ja: 最近、新しいゲームをやっています。
topic.en: I've been playing a new game lately.

topic.ja: 麻布十番のラーメンは、友達とよく行きます。
topic.en: I often go for ramen with friends in Azabujuban.

bye.ja: 日本語、がんばってください。

outings.purpose: Yui walks to work at the b roppongi
Shota heads to TV Asahi for a morning shoot
Rena walks from Roppongi Station to her dental clinic
Ryo cycles to Mozilla Japan for the day
Yui and Rena meet at Sakurazaka Park for a quick lunch
outings.talk: Yui tells Rena about a guest who asked for a late-night ramen tip and Rena teases her for always being curious about other people's food. They decide on Roppongi Wakaba because it is close to both their workplaces and has a quick lunch set.

outings.purpose: Yui walks back to the hotel after lunch
Rena walks back to her clinic after lunch
Yui, Shota, Rena and Ryo meet after work and go for yakitori
outings.talk: Shota loudly teases Ryo about his lunch order and Yui brings up a funny guest at the hotel, while Rena makes dry comments about all of them. Shota suggests Taito because it is close and has good yakitori, and everyone agrees, with Ryo only asking for a seat away from the door.

outings.purpose: Shota walks back to Akasaka after drinks
Rena takes the subway home from Roppongi
Ryo cycles home to Azabu after drinks

yui-rena-lunch.title: Lunch at Sakurazaka Park
yui-rena-lunch.note: Japanese people often say お疲れさま to coworkers or friends during the day, not only at the end of work. Adding ね to the end of a sentence, as in 高いね, invites the listener to agree and keeps talk friendly.

lines.ja: 怜奈さん、お疲れさま！今日、給料日なんだ。
lines.en: Hi Rena, good work! Today's payday, you know.

lines.ja: お疲れ。テンション高いね。何かいいことあったの？
lines.en: Hey. You're really hyped. Did something good happen?

lines.ja: あのね、昨日のお客さんが深夜のラーメン聞いてきたの。
lines.en: So, a guest yesterday asked me for a good late-night ramen spot.

lines.ja: また人のごはんの話？ほんと気になるんだね。
lines.en: Back to other people's food again? You really are curious.

lines.ja: だって気になるじゃん！六本木のお店、教えてあげた。
lines.en: Well, I'm curious! I told them about a place in Roppongi.

lines.ja: 優しいね。じゃあ、お昼どうする？時間あんまりないよ。
lines.en: That's nice of you. So, lunch? We don't have much time.

lines.ja: わかばどう？近いし、ランチセットがすぐ出るよ。
lines.en: How about Wakaba? It's close and the lunch set comes out fast.

lines.ja: いいね。じゃあ、わかばにしよう。
lines.en: Sounds good. Let's go to Wakaba then.

yui-rena-lunch.because: Yui and Rena both work close to Roppongi, so Wakaba is an easy walk from either workplace. Its quick lunch set fits their short break.

there.ja: すみません、ランチセットふたつお願いします。
there.en: Excuse me, two lunch sets please.

there.ja: 私は唐揚げ定食にする。あと、お水もね。
there.en: I'll have the karaage set. And water too, please.

there.ja: 私も同じのにしよう。今日は割り勘でいい？
there.en: I'll get the same one. Shall we split the bill today?

there.ja: えー、給料日なのにおごってくれないの？
there.en: Eh, it's payday and you won't treat me?

there.ja: 半分だけね！ちょっとだけだよ。
there.en: Half only! Just a little, okay.

there.ja: はいはい。ありがとう、ゆいちゃん。

drinks-after-work.title: Sakurazaka Park Meetup
drinks-after-work.note: Coworkers say お疲れさま to each other when they meet after work, even in casual settings. Shota's ね and じゃん and Rena's blunt replies show how Tokyo friends often tease each other while still being warm.

lines.ja: おー、みんな来た！今日めっちゃ疲れたわー。
lines.en: Oh, everyone's here! I'm so tired today.

lines.ja: お疲れさま！ねえ聞いて、今日のお客さんがおもしろくて。
lines.en: Good work! Listen, the guest today was so funny.

lines.ja: また始まった。
lines.en: Here we go again.

lines.ja: 亮、昼に何食べたか言ってみ？
lines.en: Ryo, tell us what you ate for lunch.

lines.ja: ……カレーです。
lines.en: ...Curry.

lines.ja: カレー！？まじで？寝ぼけてんじゃん。
lines.en: Curry?! Seriously? You must have been half asleep.

lines.ja: 別にいいでしょ。おいしかったです。
lines.en: What's wrong with that? It was good.

lines.ja: 亮くんのカレーはどうでもいいけど、お腹すいた。
lines.en: I don't care about Ryo's curry, but I'm hungry.

lines.ja: わかる。で、そのお客さんがね、ロビーで…
lines.en: Me too. So, that guest, in the lobby...

lines.ja: 長くなりそう。居酒屋行きながら聞こうか。
lines.en: Sounds like a long story. Let's go somewhere to eat while you tell it.

lines.ja: じゃあ、たいとでよくない？近いし焼き鳥うまいよ！
lines.en: Then how about Taito? It's close and the yakitori is great!

lines.ja: いいね！賛成！
lines.en: Nice! I agree!

lines.ja: 私もいい。
lines.en: Fine with me too.

lines.ja: ……あの、入口から遠い席がいいです。
lines.en: ...Um, I'd like a seat far from the entrance.

lines.ja: 亮、また人見知りかよ（笑）。
lines.en: Ryo, you're shy again, huh? (lol)

lines.ja: じゃ、たいとに行こ。
lines.en: Okay, let's go to Taito.

drinks-after-work.because: They meet near Sakurazaka Park after work. Shota suggests Taito because it is close and has good yakitori, and everyone agrees. Ryo asks only for a seat away from the door, so they all head there together.

there.ja: 四人です。奥の席、空いてますか？
there.en: Four of us. Is there a seat in the back?

there.ja: 焼き鳥、とりあえずもも、ねぎま、つくね頼もう！
there.en: Let's order yakitori to start: thigh, leek and chicken, and meatballs!

there.ja: 生ビールひとつ。あとレモンサワーで。
there.en: One draft beer for me. And a lemon sour after that.

there.ja: ねえ、さっきの話の続き聞いて！
there.en: Hey, listen to the rest of that story!
